basic_info.description: Park Lovers, Urban Dreamers: This Victorian Gem Has It All! Located near Buena Vista Park, the iconic Panhandle of GG Park & just steps from the vibrant Divisadero Corridor & Falletti's Market, this fully detached Victorian offers the perfect blend of dynamic city living & tranquil charm. Nestled alongside lush greenery w/ a charming plum tree & vibrant planters, the home is flooded w/ natural light & offers a thoughtfully designed floor plan that can accommodate up to 4 bdrms. Step inside to discover stunning designer details: Moroccan tiles, elegant herringbone wood floors & a sophisticated triple parlor w/ a wb frplc, perfect for entertaining. The expansive kitchen seamlessly opens onto a sun-drenched wraparound deck & a cozy sunroom w/ lrg picture window overlooking lush gardens. Upstairs, a palatial primary ste boasts breathtaking views toward St. Ignatius, a private deck for morning coffee & a spa-inspired bath w/soaking tub & walk-in steam shower. Down the hall are 3 add'l bdrms & marble-clad bath w/ a freestanding tub, walk-in shower & dbl vanity. Classy herringbone white oak floors line the hallway, offering space for a reading nook or home office. Convenient internal access leads to a spacious grg, bonus room w/ wet bar, full bath, storage/workshop space.
